scope: All eight receiving fixtures exercise the production native adapter in a disposable RackFloor preview with isolated physics. Checks cover exact dynamic unit labels/counts, physical Code128 scanning, receiving support, force-based carry, stock-preserving synchronization, rejection, Undo and camera transition cancellation. Receipt snapshots are fixtures, not company transactions. Browser pointer and keyboard input remain separate checks.
